PROVEN by a preload trace of which thread takes each X event off the socket: Mesa's swapchain thread (`WSI swapchain q`) reads winit's own connection while it finishes a present, so an event arriving then lands in the client-side queue and winit 0.30.13 sleeps on an empty socket (it checks the queue only before sleeping and after waking). Not proven: Xlib's queue was not read inside the stuck process (ptrace restricted). Base rate 5 lost runs in 100 (release list example, xvfb, software Vulkan); after the fix 0 in 200 (1,400 events). Fix in `host/shell.rs`, X11 only: each presented frame starts a wake schedule (16 ms doubling to 2,048 ms, then none); a wake runs no turn unless the program's deadline has come; an idle window wakes zero times.
